She wears a hooded gray robe with a darker waist sash, an ankle-length robe skirt with a slightly darker hem, and goes barefoot with simple ankle wraps. Pale skin, dark hair just visible under the hood, a clearly readable young face in profile with a visible eye, brow, nose and mouth. Realistic child body proportions, about 5.5 head-heights tall, matching the reference turnaround exactly in design, coloring and proportions. Rendered as a single cohesive hand-painted illustration with soft painterly brushwork and visible brush texture, in a muted earthy palette (grays, browns, warm skin tones), NOT a flat vector cutout, in the painted-storybook register of games like Hollow Knight or GRIS. The peak instant of a fast horizontal dash burst: her torso is bent into a steep, hard forward lean -- much steeper than a normal running lean -- head tucked low and forward, both arms swept sharply back and bent at the elbows, both legs bent and trailing behind her, streamlined and compact for speed, like a sprinter caught mid-lunge at full speed. This is NOT a jump, NOT a fall, and NOT a normal running stride -- read it as an explosive burst of pure horizontal speed. Full body visible from the top of the hood to the soles of both bare feet, and both hands, entirely inside the canvas with generous empty margin on every side so nothing is cropped. She stands at a consistent scale and vertical position: the same distance from the top of her hood to the ground line as in the reference image(s). Transparent background, no ground plane, no cast shadow, no vignette, no border, no text, no watermark, no second copy of the character, no scarf or neck wrap of any kind -- bare gray robe collar at the neck; a separate layer will add the scarf later.
